actual_behavior_limitation: `library_content_identity` reads and hashes every file under each --library root on every `mncs call`, including build outputs, evidence, and dot directories (mncs-test: 367MB, of which 340MB is native-applications output). A broad workspace root costs tens of seconds per invocation before compilation starts; there is no filtering or memoization.
alternatives_considered: each consumer narrows roots (done in mncs-debug; fragile across the family)
current_workaround: mncs-debug passes narrow source-only roots; other consumers may still pass broad roots.
expected_semantics: Library identity covers compilation-relevant inputs only (source files, not build outputs/dot dirs), or is memoized across calls with mtime/size invalidation. A repeated identical call never rehashes hundreds of megabytes.

host_language_code_required.why: No host code involved; the gap is hashing scope inside the toolchain.

minimal_reproducer.command: pass a workspace root containing build outputs as --library to `mncs call`; observe tens of seconds before cache lookup (MNCS_TIMINGS admission-total)

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: Restrict library hashing to recognized source suffixes and skip conventional output directories (target, .git, .mncs, native-applications), or memoize per-root digests keyed by (path, size, mtime) with rehash on change.
resolution_criteria: A repeated identical native call with a broad library root completes without re-reading build-output bytes; timings show identity computation under ~100ms warm.
tests_evidence: decide() 30-92s with broad root, 8.2s warm with narrow roots
title: Native library identity hashes all files under library roots per call
why_capability_matters: Any consumer passing a workspace root as a library pays tens of seconds per native call; the debugger hit this on every semantic query until it narrowed its own roots.
